subjectPopulation: Census usually resident population, all ages and sexes
implementationRequirements: Preserve original ethnicity categories and multiple responses; do not normalize these overlapping margins into an exclusive race draw.
Use compatible single/combination observations before fitting mixed-background probabilities; marginal totals alone do not identify combinations.
Keep ethnicity, descent and birthplace separate; national residents are not a New-Zealand-born or NFL recruitment cohort.
Do not translate reported identity or these counts directly into skin, eye, hair or athletic distributions.
limitations: No age-by-sex-by-birthplace-by-ethnicity joint extraction has been adopted from this source.
Source combines census responses, earlier censuses, administrative data and imputation; it is not entirely direct current self-response.
Rounded published percentages and overlapping categories do not sum to 100 percent.
No runtime coefficients or existing saved player identities changed.
